name: Eclipse City
source:
Eclipse City is a visual novel with action, sci-fi, and romance themes. The story follows a human Texas Ranger (Default name: Jack) who ended up in a futuristic world populated by anthropomorphic canines and felines. As he tries to maintain his new life in Eclipse City, the Texas Ranger will meet allies and enemies. Will he survive Eclipse City or will Eclipse City consume him?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20230716154733/https://johnwolfen.itch.io/eclipsecity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Eclipse City》是一部以动作、科幻和浪漫为主题的视觉小说。故事讲述了一位人类德克萨斯游骑兵（默认名称：杰克），他最终来到了一个充满拟人化的犬科动物和猫科动物的未来世界。当德克萨斯游骑兵试图维持他在日食城的新生活时，他将遇到盟友和敌人。他会在日蚀城中幸存下来还是会被日蚀城吞噬？

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20230716154733/https://johnwolfen.itch.io/eclipsecity]Itch.io[/url]]
